title: Abyssals v0.90.40 — Berries and Branches
notes: Adds two new item-branch families with ten original battle portraits and matching directional followers. Flaskling is rare at levels 5–8 in Dorelem Scrub and gains half EXP; use a sin item at level 40+ in Hell. Scruffox is rare at levels 8–12 on North Scrub Road; four relics evolve it at level 30. Reggifox is Fighting/Psychic with buffing and special attacks. All eight evolution items are in Marasen’s Evolution Atelier. Adds twelve consumable held Berries linked to existing Berry abilities, eight broad-role held items, and Mabel Rowan’s illustrated farm-shop pantry in Dorelem’s upper-left stablehouse. Tightens item crops, adds pictures throughout the bag, retires Patient Rations with a one-for-one Slow Stew conversion, adds the Grand Exchange lift and corrects Waranwei’s walking direction. Preserves saves, quests, permanent deaths, package identity and original signing. Includes the rebuilt offline PWA.
